goals: Close verified material-form holes with original additive blocks, starting with masonry details whose comparable Macaw Paths profiles have no BBB counterpart.
Keep Interchangeable Block Families as the sole Clutter No More ShapeMap authority while AMC owns only its original blocks, data, recipes, and presentation.
scope: Canary 1 owns exactly five original detail forms—column, urn, moulding, fence, and frame—for exactly Andesite, Diorite, Granite, Brick, Mossy Stone Brick, Cobbled Deepslate, Mud Brick, and Dark Prismarine.
Every C1 form has a self-drop, a native-material stonecutting recipe and advancement, a pickaxe tag, an English display name, and original JSON models that reference only Minecraft base textures.
C1 is an additive content candidate only: it supplies no ShapeMap data, no provider-registry inference, no compatibility implementation, and no claimed manual Minecraft runtime result.

exclusions: Copying, bundling, redistributing, or deriving textures, models, code, data, or recipes from Macaw's, Building But Better, or another third-party provider.
A second ShapeMap, equivalence, switching, recipe-cleanup, networking, or storage system; Interchangeable Block Families remains the sole authority for those concerns.
Dynamic material discovery, registry-name or tag inference, provider mutation, replacing a provider block, or creating an alternate item in another provider namespace.
Minecraft deployment, testing-profile access, runtime-state mutation, acceptance, or inferring manual runtime success from static checks.
